name: db
rules:
webhooks:
  - name: sink
    url: ${WEBHOOK_URL}/db
    template: '{"text": {{ json .Text }}}'

rules:
  - name: db-errors
    files: ["/var/log/demo/db.log"]
    pattern: 'ERROR (?P<code>\w+)'
    severity: critical
    webhooks: [sink]
    suppress: {window: 1m, group_by: code}

  # Absence rule: the database logs a checkpoint every few seconds; if that
  # stops for 2 minutes, something is stuck.
  - name: db-heartbeat
    files: ["/var/log/demo/db.log"]
    absent: 'checkpoint complete'
    for: 2m
    severity: critical
    webhooks: [sink]
